newsitem.title: USA: Los Angeles County says will face budget challenge.
newsitem.headline: Los Angeles County says will face budget challenge.

text.p: Los Angeles County will encounter serious budget challenges in the coming fiscal years as a result of federal welfare reform, a state audit released on Thursday said.

"The federal welfare reform bill, recently signed by the president, will significantly reduce the funding the county receives for federal welfare programs beginning in fiscal year 1997-98," the state audit said.
In addition, the state Auditor's report said the county faces several legal challenges over reductions in the amount of cash grants that it provides to indigent county residents.
